task: I’m helping a family member shop for an affordable used Toyota and want a realistic comparison across a couple of car sites before we decide what to pursue. On Edmunds, please search around Augusta, Georgia and find the cheapest used Toyota RAV4 listing that has both AWD and heated seats, then open the actual vehicle listing so you can confirm those features on the page and note the price, year, mileage, dealer or seller, and anything else basic that stands out; leave that listing open in its own tab so I can look at the photos and details later. Then, using that RAV4 as the benchmark for what the market looks like, go to Cars.com and search for any used Toyota within 50 miles of Augusta, GA priced at $10,000 or less, and open one matching listing that seems like a good budget reference so I can see what a lower-cost Toyota option looks like on another marketplace; keep that listing open too so I can compare the two tabs side by side. After that, on CarGurus, pull up the comparison details for the Toyota Camry XLE AWD and the Mazda3 Turbo Hatchback and capture the key specs for each — engine, horsepower, drivetrain, fuel economy, and MSRP — because I want to know whether sticking with Toyota’s AWD choices makes more sense than considering a non-Toyota AWD alternative. In the end, send me a concise summary with the Edmunds RAV4 listing details, the Cars.com budget Toyota listing details, and the side-by-side spec comparison.

### 1. Edmunds: Cheapest Used Toyota RAV4 with AWD & Heated Seats
- **Tab:** **Tab ID 2052873240** (*Title: "2009 Toyota RAV4 - VIN: JTMBK31V995078467"*) — **Left open in its own tab**
- **Vehicle:** 2009 Toyota RAV4 Limited 4dr SUV 4WD
- **Price:** $11,588 (Rated "Fair Price", $288 below market)
- **Year:** 2009
- **Mileage:** 105,636 miles
- **Dealer / Seller:** Driveway (Online dealership, Chesapeake, VA 23320 with direct home delivery to Augusta, GA)
- **Features Confirmed on Page:**
  - **Drivetrain:** Four-Wheel Drive (AWD / 4WD)
  - **Seats:** Heated front seats (with Sand Beige leather seating)
- **Notable Highlights:**
  - Powertrain: 3.5L V6 Gas engine producing 269 hp with a 5-speed automatic transmission (19 City / 26 Hwy MPG)
  - Options: Sunroof/moonroof, backup camera, keyless entry/start
  - Vehicle History: 0 accidents reported, 1 owner, personal use, clean title (VIN: `JTMBK31V995078467`)

---

### 2. Cars.com: Budget Reference Toyota Under $10,000 (Within 50 Miles of Augusta, GA)
- **Tab:** **Tab ID 2052873241** (*Title: "Used 2009 Toyota Camry BASE For Sale $8,495 | Cars.com"*) — **Left open in its own tab**
- **Vehicle:** 2009 Toyota Camry BASE
- **Price:** $8,495 (Rated "Good Deal", no dealer fees, $1,500 below original list price)
- **Year:** 2009 (identical model year to the RAV4 benchmark)
- **Mileage:** 116,232 miles (comparable mileage to the RAV4's 105k)
- **Dealer / Seller:** Jiggie's Truck & Auto Sales LLC (1434 Edgefield Rd, North Augusta, SC 29860 — 12 miles from Augusta, GA)
- **Notable Highlights:**
  - Powertrain: 2.4L 4-cylinder engine paired with a **manual transmission** (rare for a Camry sedan) and Front-Wheel Drive (FWD)
  - Color: Blue Ribbon Metallic exterior
  - Context vs. Benchmark: At $8,495, it saves $3,093 compared to the $11,588 RAV4, offering a reliable local reference point if AWD, heated seats, and an SUV body style are not mandatory.

---

### 3. CarGurus: Side-by-Side Spec Comparison (Toyota Camry XLE AWD vs. Mazda3 Turbo Hatchback)
- **Reference Page:** **Tab ID 2052873101** (*CarGurus Custom Comparison*)

| Spec | Toyota Camry XLE AWD | Mazda3 2.5 Turbo Premium Plus Hatchback AWD |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **MSRP** | **$36,325** | **$38,090** |
| **Engine** | 2.5L 4-Cylinder Hybrid (HEV) | 2.5L 4-Cylinder Turbocharged Gas |
| **Horsepower** | 232 hp | 250 hp @ 5,000 rpm (320 lb-ft torque) |
| **Drivetrain** | All-Wheel Drive (AWD) | All-Wheel Drive (i-Activ AWD) |
| **Fuel Economy** | **46 City / 46 Highway MPG** | 23 City / 31 Highway MPG |

#### Takeaway for Your AWD Decision:
- **Toyota Camry XLE AWD:** Significantly lower starting price ($1,765 less MSRP), vastly superior fuel efficiency (46 mpg combined vs ~26 mpg), and the practicality of a roomier midsize sedan with Toyota’s proven hybrid AWD system.
- **Mazda3 Turbo Hatchback AWD:** More performance-oriented (250 hp / 320 lb-ft torque) and offers hatchback utility with an upscale interior, but carries a higher price tag and cuts your city fuel economy in half.
